cleaning.reason: Can't be attributed to a customer
Postage, fees, discounts and manual lines aren't purchases
Kept separately for the return rate, not counted as sales

cleaning.rule: Zero or negative quantity or price

segments.name: Champions
segments.tagline: Order often, ordered recently, spend the most
segments.action: Protect the relationship: an account manager, early access to new ranges, ask for referrals.

segments.name: Slowing regulars
segments.tagline: Several orders, but the last one was about two months ago
segments.action: Check in before they lapse: reorder reminders, a call for the larger accounts.

segments.name: Newcomers
segments.tagline: First orders in the last few months
segments.action: Win the second and third order: onboarding, best sellers, a reorder reminder.

segments.name: Gone quiet
segments.action: Low-cost reactivation by email; don't spend heavily here.
